_doc: The login screen's backgrounds, shared by every client (tools/screenshots/README.md, Login screen backgrounds). The same format as shots.json: positions are server (Kod) squares in the room `rid`, standing at the square's centre; `angle` is Kod's 0-4095 (0 east, 1024 south, 2048 west, 3072 north); `pitch` tilts the look in degrees (negative down); `time` is a DM time of day. NPCs' squares come from the Kod (each shot's note), so aim at them from a few squares off. Found with shards.pose() and scouted in the game.
_viewports: 32 CSS pixels taller than the picture: the browser keeps its title bar (TitleBar.tsx) above the view, so the view is 1920x1080 (3840x2160) and 915x412 (a landscape phone)
_web: The copies the login screen shows (npm run assets copies them into the game files as login/*.webp): WebP, desktop ones scaled to 2560x1440, the phone's as taken
